player_prompt.intro:
Nge o Player {player_id} na ludi ya Indian Poker.
- 52-kadi deck; nge mona kaka kadi ya mpinzani.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila mzunguko, {max_rounds} mzunguko(s) kwa jumla.
- Mikendo ya kawaida: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari chanya <= hesabu ya chip yako.)
- Kadi ya juu iliyojificha inashinda poti kwenye showdown.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kaadi ya mpinzani wako ni: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pesa mo action mokei na bracket, mpenza '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Ntalu ya mbongo yina bo fwete tula to kufuta sambu na kununga fwete vanda ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Nge lenda binga ve ata muntu mosi; nge lenda [check] na kisika ya kubinga yandi.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Sadila [bet X] sambu na kukangula; nge lenda tomisa ve.
invalid_move.insufficient: Yo kele ve ti mbongo ya kufwana sambu na kusala kisalu yina.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown sawa: zote mbili {card}. Poti imegawanywa – kila mmoja anapokea {split}.

outcome.draw: Bo ta vanda kaka ti batapi ya kiteso mosi na nima ya ba ronde yonso.
